name: Can a consultation determine if I need a repair or a full replacement?

mainEntity.name: Can a consultation determine if I need a repair or a full replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a roofing project scope consultation is designed to determine whether a repair or a full replacement is the most appropriate solution for your roof. The assessment will consider the extent of damage, the age of the roof, and its overall structural integrity. A specialist from Discounted Roofing Co. will provide an expert recommendation based on these factors, weighing the long-term cost-effectiveness and durability of each option.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a consultation assesses damage, age, and integrity to recommend if repair or full replacement is needed.
